responsibility: This header defines GCC’s sparse set data structure for integer sets over a fixed-size universe. It describes the sparseset_def layout with dense and sparse arrays plus iterator state, provides O(1) inline operations for clear, cardinality, membership, insertion, pop, and iteration, and declares the out-of-line set algebra routines implemented in sparseset.cc. It is the public interface for a sparse integer-set representation optimized for fast enumeration and constant-time updates when the universe size is known in advance.
same_name_distinction: This .h file defines the sparseset representation and its inline constant-time operations and iteration macros, while gcc/sparseset.cc supplies the out-of-line allocator and multi-set algorithms like copy, intersection, difference, union, and equality.
